SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Divine storm-bird embodying chaotic ambition, theft of divine power, and rebellion against cosmic order
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The rebel who steals destiny itself - chaos grasping at cosmic order

Correspondences.Color: Storm Black, Lightning White, Chaos Gray

DevelopmentalArc: Divine Servant → Ambitious Plot → Theft of Tablet → Chaos Reign → Hero Combat → Defeat → Order Restored

MythicAppearances: Anzu and the Tablet of Destinies (Akkadian)
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Represented chaos to be overcome, used in heroic narratives, apotropaic imagery (sometimes), symbol of storm power
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient storm-bird deity became chaotic rebel in mythology, sometimes benevolent in early texts, later predominantly negative chaos monster
SyncreticForms: Prometheus (thief of divine power - though heroic)

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as massive bird with lion's head, storm clouds for wings, grasping Tablet of Destinies, monstrous and fierce, in combat with gods
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the storm that stole the sky's decrees, the rebel who grasped destiny, the chaos that heroes must defeat.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A monstrous bird stealing the laws of reality; storm wings carrying off cosmic order; ambition becoming chaos

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for understanding rebellion, chaos work, ambition's shadow, confronting usurpation
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a storm-bird who steals the very tablets of fate, whose ambition brings chaos that heroes must overcome.
Create a rebel who grasps cosmic power beyond their station, embodying chaotic ambition.
